## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 基础分区过滤
WHERE grass_date = DATE('${bizdate}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${REGION}')

-- Shop 点击事件
WHERE grass_date = DATE('${bizdate}')
  AND operation = 1002
  AND grass_region = upper('${REGION}')

-- Shop 曝光+点击（baseline 场景）
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND operation IN (1001, 1002)
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

### JOIN 1: UNION ALL with item tracking (反欺诈)

```sql
-- 与 dwd_advertise_tracking_item_di UNION ALL 合并 item + shop 事件
SELECT user_id, shop_id, null as item_id, ads_id, ...
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_shop_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = DATE('${bizdate}')
  AND operation = 1002
  AND grass_region = upper('${REGION}')
UNION ALL
SELECT user_id, shop_id, item_id, ads_id, ...
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_item_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date = DATE('${bizdate}')
  AND operation = 2
  AND grass_region = upper('${REGION}')
```

### JOIN 2: LEFT JOIN with advertiser transaction (反欺诈扣费关联)

```sql
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ads_id, grass_region, placement, event_timestamp
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertiser_transaction_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${bizdate}')
      AND grass_region = upper('${REGION}')
      AND event_code = 1
) trans
ON track.ads_id = trans.ads_id
   AND track.grass_region = trans.grass_region
   AND track.placement = trans.placement
   AND track.event_timestamp = trans.event_timestamp
```

### JOIN 3: INNER JOIN with order items (基线归因)

```sql
-- 通过 user_id, shop_id, item_id/placement, grass_region, time window 关联订单
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT grass_region, create_datetime AS event_timestamp
        , buyer_id AS user_id, shop_id, item_id, order_id
        , SUM(order_price_pp_usd * item_amount) AS order_price_usd
        , SUM(gmv_usd) AS gmv_usd
    FROM mp_order.dwd_order_item_place_pay_complete_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
      AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
      AND is_placed = 1 AND is_paid_ads_topup = 0
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
) o
ON o.user_id = t.user_id
   AND o.shop_id = t.shop_id
   AND (o.item_id = t.item_id OR t.placement = 3)
   AND o.grass_region = t.grass_region
   AND t.trans_timestamp BETWEEN (o.event_timestamp - INTERVAL 6 DAYS) AND o.event_timestamp
```

### JOIN 4: LEFT JOIN with reserved keywords (品牌词识别)

```sql
LEFT JOIN kw
ON kw.grass_region = c.grass_region
   AND kw.keyword = c.keyword
WHERE placement = 3
  AND operation = 1002
  AND kw.keyword IS NOT NULL
  AND kw.keyword != ''
```

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- 按 placement + entrance 统计曝光/点击
SELECT grass_date, grass_region
    , CAST(ads_placement AS varchar) AS ads_placement
    , ads_entrance
    , SUM(IF(operation = 1001, 1, 0)) AS impression_cnt
    , SUM(IF(operation = 1002, 1, 0)) AS click_cnt
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_shop_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE coalesce(ads_id, 0) > 0 AND user_id > 0
  AND grass_date = DATE('${bizdate}')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4

-- Shop baseline metrics (cache)
SELECT grass_region, grass_date, operation
    , coalesce(tracking_placement, 3) AS placement
    , LOWER(query.keyword) AS keyword
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_shop_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND grass_date = DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND operation IN (1001, 1002)

-- 曝光聚合 (baseline)
SELECT grass_region, grass_date, placement, count(*) AS impression
FROM tracking_shop
WHERE operation = 1001 AND placement = 3
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

-- 点击聚合 (baseline)
SELECT grass_region, grass_date, placement, count(*) AS click
FROM tracking_shop
WHERE operation = 1002 AND placement = 3
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

### Snippet 2: Tracking vs Performance 差异对比

```sql
-- tracking_shop 数据
SELECT 'tracking' AS data_from
    , CAST(ads_placement AS varchar) AS ads_placement
    , ads_entrance
    , SUM(IF(operation = 1001, 1, 0)) AS impression_cnt
    , SUM(IF(operation = 1002, 1, 0)) AS click_cnt
    , grass_date, grass_region
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_shop_di_presto__reg_s0_live
WHERE coalesce(ads_id, 0) > 0 AND user_id > 0
  AND grass_date = DATE('${bizdate}')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 6, 7
```

### Snippet 3: Baseline 品牌词点击识别

```sql
-- 区分保留品牌词点击 (placement=-3) 和普通 shop 点击 (placement=3)
SELECT c.grass_region, c.grass_date
    , -1 * c.placement AS placement, COUNT(1) AS click
FROM tracking_shop c
INNER JOIN kw
ON kw.grass_region = c.grass_region AND kw.keyword = c.keyword
WHERE placement = 3 AND operation = 1002
  AND kw.keyword IS NOT NULL AND kw.keyword != ''
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
```

### Snippet 4: 订单归因 -- shop ads 7天回溯窗口

```sql
-- shop ads 下单归因（包含常规 shop click 和 placement=3 的 shop page click）
SELECT grass_region
    , CASE WHEN grass_region IN ('ID','TH','VN') THEN ...
           ELSE from_unixtime(`timestamp`, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')
      END AS trans_timestamp
    , user_id, shop_id
    , NULL AS item_id
    , coalesce(tracking_placement, 3) AS placement
    , LOWER(query.keyword) AS keyword
FROM mkplpaidads_data.dwd_advertise_tracking_shop_di__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN DATE_ADD(DATE('${grass_date}'), -6) AND DATE('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
  AND operation = 1002
```

### 关键转换逻辑：grass_date 时区转换

```sql
CASE
  WHEN grass_region IN ('ID', 'TH', 'VN')
    THEN DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(CONCAT(grass_date, ' ', lpad(h, 2, 0), ':00:00'), 'UTC+08:00'), 'Asia/Jakarta'))
  WHEN grass_region IN ('BR')
    THEN DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(..., 'UTC+08:00'), 'America/Araguaina'))
  WHEN grass_region IN ('MX')
    THEN DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(..., 'UTC+08:00'), 'America/Mexico_City'))
  WHEN grass_region IN ('CO')
    THEN DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(..., 'UTC+08:00'), 'America/Bogota'))
  WHEN grass_region IN ('CL')
    THEN DATE(FROM_UTC_TIMESTAMP(TO_UTC_TIMESTAMP(..., 'UTC+08:00'), 'America/Santiago'))
  ELSE grass_date
END AS grass_date
```
